title: Wife Hazel and the names Dominique and Don Albert
summary: Albert gives his wife's maiden name and full name, and explains how people use Mrs. Dominique while he is listed in the phone book as Don Albert.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: What's her name now? Let's get it all right.
Her maiden name was Geringer. G-U-E-R-I-G-E-R. The people around here say Geringer. That's the French way of saying it. But the English way is Geringer.
Well, she calls herself Mrs. Dominique. A lot of people address her as this is Mrs. Dominique.

So, sometimes it becomes confusing. But everybody who knows, I know, have one in San Antonio. There's no problem now because they still call me Don Albert. And that's out of telephone. The name is listed in the telephone. It's Don Albert. Don Albert. So, some of these guys are traveling through the state and they want to see me. They look up at Albert Dominique which they're not going to find me anymore. But they'll find my son's name. And they'll call his number and get my name.
